arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Deutsch argued this is an Administrative Procedure Act case. She said the agency must show reasoned decision-making.
Mr. Stewart argued Section 202(h) reflects Congress's conclusion. He said competitive developments make old restrictions unwarranted.
Ms. Walker argued the FCC decided broadcasters should not follow old rules. She cited statutory reasons for lawful reform.
